segments.t: 2027 is going to be really, really challenging for the stock market. And I say that because
if I just look at the flows, and that's probably what we look at the most. It's what I look at the
most. You probably got the most negative flow picture for the US stock market that we've had,
say, since 2002. And by that, I mean, we sum up all the buybacks, M&A, all the positive things
that has powered this market so much for the past, say, since 2009. If I sum up all those,
and then I subtract from that the IPOs, secondaries, unlocks, et cetera, then you've got
certainly the most negative flow picture since 2009. So that underlying corporate support
that was there year in, year out has now really shifted when
